comment: The overall relevance and usability of the framework are clear, and the necessary information is present. WHO makes it clear that a framework serving as worldwide guidance for designing an integrated national digital health system is an unmet need, and this blueprint will stimulate and help countries to create one. IPC also perceives the organisation of digital health across the regions of the world as fragmented, so this connecting framework is welcome. The examples of what DPI-H can offer are important.
